actions.label: resolve a (tier, scale, size) triple to a control height by the tier formula
look up inset, text and icon for a ladder height; reject an off-table height
derive caption text and chip height/inset/text from the compact row (largest row at or below height minus inset, chip capped at the caller's height)
derive the icon-height ratio per cell (precise, not rounded)
derive control, mark, inset and card radius for the kit's radius mode (default/round/sharp/pill)
compose each cell's text (and chip text) from the Type UI scale, value-neutral at defaults
emit all 27 cells as CSS custom properties in our grammar under the kit's prefix
emit the CSS context resolver: data-tier/data-scale/data-size/data-radius -> --control-*, --chip-*, --radius-control/-mark/-inset/-card, --control-micro-*
emit DTCG dimension tokens for the 27 cells and the container ladders
emit Figma FLOAT variables: 27 mode-constant cells plus per-breakpoint-mode aliases bound to that mode's scale
emit per-breakpoint CSS override files from each mode's scale
persist tier, scale, radius mode, space base and per-mode scale; drop unknown ids with a report
migrate a saved kit forward: treatment/baseHeight -> nearest (tier, scale) by md-cell height; modes[].baseHeight -> modes[].scale; drop rampContrast, ramp, tokenOverrides via DROPPED_KEYS
choose tier, scale, radius mode and space base in the Geometry inspector
preview all 27 cells (default cell pinned) as live controls in light and dark on the canvas
edit breakpoint modes as a scale per mode (standard set: Desktop=md, Desktop Lg/Xl=lg, Tablet/Mobile=sm)
serve the ladder over MCP get_geometry / brand://geometry with a description naming tier x scale x size
size the PNG swatch-board mock controls from the kit's LG-equivalent cell (product-lg-md)
emit the design-system bundle geometry layer, icon sizes and the Buttons size-ladder row from cells
keep the M3 radius ladder, space, insets, gaps, borders and focus seeds unchanged so shadcn/Panda/Radix/Tailwind and the pinned Adia artifacts hold
apply the new variable paths to an existing Figma file, aliasing old size/{step} and size/{0..9} variables to cells by nearest legacy height with a deterministic tiebreak
ship the rename map so a renamed emitted variable keeps its Figma id
gate the 27 cells against the vendored Maison rows: values, anatomy identity, compact row, 108 radius values
gate the resolver cascade in a real browser (nearest axis wins, 27 x 4 radius cases, an override on --control-height wins)
gate persist allowlists and the consumer skill's token names against the engine
record the decision and the Maison->ours name map in an ADR; repair the geometry-system, type-scale and consumer skills, the geometry README and the MCP README in the same change
route every ordered or named-cell lookup through orderedSizeNames/sizeAnchor/mdAnchor so no consumer learns the cell naming
keep the Adia preset valid after linear4 retires (remove geometry.ramp from brands.json) and regenerate its derived artifacts per their bump policy
retire caret, icon-gap, density, padding-wide, the compact pads, pill-radius and the .control-{step} classes, each named in the migration notes
re-key the UI-control and UI-widget voices from six t-shirt steps to the height-indexed Maison text table and retire their fixed six-step rows from the type emitters
size an icon box, an indicator (caret, chevron, dot) and a mark (check, radio, switch thumb) from the cell: box = icon, indicator glyph = text, mark corner = mark radius
size a chip (kbd, tooltip, stepper marker, breadcrumb separator) from the chip row and a badge from height minus inset, with the inset radius
size a caption/note under a choice control from the caption text role
let the app shell set data-tier/data-scale/data-size/data-radius on the <ultimate-tokens> host from doc.geometry (default product/md/md/round) and expose a user override

migrate styles.css fixed px control rules (buttons, inputs, selects, segmented, chips, switch thumb, mode controls) to the shell aliases, incrementally by selector group, pixels approved per screenshot
size icons.js glyphs from --control-icon instead of a size literal, with the literal as the fallback until the host attributes exist
keep the headless shim green: the shell migration changes CSS only, never the DOM the shim asserts

edges.why: derivations read the resolved cell rows
the scale shape carries the derived fields
emitters iterate the new cells shape
the join composes per cell height
persist allowlists mirror the engine ids
the section renders and previews emitter output
ds-export and MCP read the resolved scale and emitters
the binder reconciles the emitted variable paths
records cite the final names and shape
glyph roles are derivations of the cell row
emitters carry the glyph and container roles
the shell reads the resolver the engine emits
